name: Number Merge
description: Drag or tap a number onto the one next to it to merge them. Make 5 and 10, doubles, exact sums, tens and hundreds, differences, times tables and fractions of one whole.
author: Koda Math Lab

features.name: Play together
features.description: Friends race the same lesson with the same questions. XP and stars still come from each child's own answers.

features.name: Spoken voice
features.description: Reads the lesson prompt aloud. Turn off for a silent lesson.

features.name: Sound chimes
features.description: Plays a short sound when tiles merge, and when a merge is right or wrong.

features.name: Haptic vibration
features.description: Adds a small vibration when a merge is right or wrong.

features.name: Drag to merge
features.description: Lets children drag a number onto its neighbour. Turn off to merge by tapping only.

settingsSchema.label: Speech rate
settingsSchema.help: How fast Koda reads the prompt aloud.
